name: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR
role: President and Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces
bio: Bola Ahmed Tinubu was sworn in as President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria on 29 May 2023. The Renewed Hope Agenda is the governing framework of his administration, and the Renewed Hope Youth Engagement takes its name and its policy direction from that agenda.

name: Vice President Kashim Shettima, GCON
role: Vice President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
bio: Kashim Shettima has served as Vice President since 29 May 2023, and previously as Governor of Borno State and Senator for Borno Central. Youth development and human-capital programmes fall within the administration's Renewed Hope priorities.

name: Prof. Nentawe Goshwe Yilwatda
bio: Prof. Nentawe Goshwe Yilwatda became National Chairman of the All Progressives Congress in 2025 and was returned to the office at the party's national convention in Abuja in March 2026. He previously served as Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction.

name: Ali Bukar Dalori
role: Deputy National Chairman (North), All Progressives Congress
bio: Ali Bukar Dalori serves as Deputy National Chairman (North) of the All Progressives Congress, a position to which he was returned at the party's March 2026 national convention.

name: Dr. Benjamin Obi Nwoye
role: Deputy National Chairman (South), All Progressives Congress
bio: Dr. Benjamin Obi Nwoye serves as Deputy National Chairman (South) of the All Progressives Congress, a position to which he was returned at the party's March 2026 national convention.

name: Sen. Surajudeen Ajibola Basiru
bio: Sen. Surajudeen Ajibola Basiru serves as National Secretary of the All Progressives Congress, returned to the office at the party's March 2026 national convention. He previously represented Osun Central in the Senate.

name: Prof. AbdulKarim Abubakar Kana
role: Deputy National Secretary, All Progressives Congress
bio: Prof. AbdulKarim Abubakar Kana serves as Deputy National Secretary of the All Progressives Congress, returned to the office at the party's March 2026 national convention.

name: Hon. Abdulazeez Abubakar Kaka
bio: Hon. Abdulazeez Abubakar Kaka is the National Coordinator of the Renewed Hope Youth Engagement. He has led the inauguration of state coordinating structures across the federation, including Plateau State in August 2026 and Benue State, and has used those platforms to set out the administration's interventions in student financing, security welfare and state allocations. His name also appears in some published reports as Abdurazez Abubakar Kaka.

name: Manji Wilson
bio: Manji Wilson is the Plateau State Coordinator of the Renewed Hope Youth Engagement. The Plateau State Coordinating Unit was inaugurated in Jos on Wednesday 5 August 2026 by Deputy Governor Mrs. Josephine Piyo, representing Governor Caleb Manasseh Mutfwang, who pledged government support for the programme. He also serves as Chief Technical Adviser on Development Partnerships, Strategic Linkages and Diaspora Engagements to the Governor of Plateau State, and is the state's Point of Contact for the Open Government Partnership, coordinating its work on transparency and accountability. In 2026 he was selected by the French government for its Future Leaders Invitation Programme. Some published reports render his name as Wilson Manji.

name: Deputy National Coordinator
bio: Profile to be published. The Deputy National Coordinator supports the National Coordinator on programme delivery and the coordination of zonal structures.

name: National Woman Leader
bio: Profile to be published. The National Woman Leader drives the participation of young women across the programme's state and local government structures.

name: Zonal Coordinators
bio: Profiles to be published. Zonal Coordinators link the National Secretariat to the state coordinating units across the six geopolitical zones — North Central, North East, North West, South East, South South and South West.

name: State Coordinating Units
bio: Profiles to be published. Each state coordinating unit is inaugurated in the state capital and is responsible for local government and ward-level mobilisation within that state.
